title.narrative: Capacity support to Caritas Jerusalem - Grants and Research Officer

description.narrative:
This project responds to Caritas Jerusalem’s (CJ) strategic planning process, which identified the need for additional capacity to enhance its grant management, compliance, research, and monitoring efforts. By supporting the Grant and Research Officer position, the project will enable CJ to develop high-quality grant proposals, improve donor/partner compliance, conduct robust needs assessments, and strengthen evidence-based programming.
Sitting at the intersection of grants, compliance, and research & monitoring, this role will ensure that CJ’s programmes are well-designed, data-driven, and aligned with grant requirements. The position will also contribute to better internal coordination, timely reporting, and improved funding success rates, ultimately enhancing the organisation’s sustainability.
By funding this role, CAFOD is investing in Caritas Jerusalem’s long-term capacity to lead and manage its humanitarian and development work effectively. This aligns with CAFOD’s broader commitment to strengthening local partners by supporting organisational development, reducing external dependency, and ensuring that humanitarian action is driven by those closest to the communities they serve.
